params.body:
Four observations from the owner's first look at the showroom download on the preview (2026-09-17), all in the drawing or in the zip. Rule R S2-7.16 updated. `SLIDE_VERSION` bumped once (1 and 4 change the drawing), so every cached slide is drawn again exactly once.

## 1. Fuel name no longer cut

"PHEV Hybri…" while the panel had room. The specs column now starts at 1360 px (was 1455; the photo's cap moves from 1340 to 1280 so a panoramic photo stops before the column). A value that does not fit at 50 px goes one step smaller (42 px), then wraps on two lines (breaking on spaces and after a slash), and only then gets an ellipsis. The three rows stay centred on the photo; a wrapped row pushes the others apart.

Checked at 1920 px with the longest names known here (`FlexLeaseService` names the production list: "PHEV Hybride - Benzine", "MHEV Hybride - Diesel", the fr/de counterparts, and "Elektrisch/Benzine hybride" from an earlier finding): all fit without an ellipsis, pinned in `ShowroomSlideTest::test_the_longest_fuel_names_fit_the_specs_column_without_an_ellipsis`. The full production `vehicle_fuel_types` table is not in the repo; a name longer than about 26 characters in one language would still wrap on two lines and could be cut on the second (`wrap()` is pure and tested for that case).

## 2. Empty showroom

With zero showroom vehicles the Download block is not rendered; the tab shows one sentence, "Geen wagens voor de showroom; vink wagens aan in het eigen wagenpark." (`showroom.download_none`, nl/fr/en/de). `SettingsPhoneLayoutTest` now uses a seeded dealer with vehicles for the download-label check, since the test dealer had none.

## 3. Rebuild proportional to change

With every slide cached, a rebuild still fetched all 630 from the bucket and zipped them again in 8 s poll slices. Now:

- the last ready zip stays per dealer, with `manifest.json` (`{vehicle_id: fingerprint}`) next to it;
- a build freezes the ids (one query, in the click), and the first slice makes the plan (`BuildShowroomZip::plan`): fingerprints of the current set without rendering, diffed against the manifest and the zip's entries; only changed and new entries are replaced (`ZipArchive::addFromString` overwrites), gone entries are deleted, and the manifest is written when the build is ready;
- progress counts `unchanged` / `updated` / `added` / `removed`; `done` starts at `unchanged`, so the tab jumps to "612 van 630" before the first slide is drawn;
- no manifest, or a zip that does not open: full build. A stop or a failure throws zip and manifest away, so the next build is full too;
- local mirror of the slide cache under `storage/app/showroom-cache/{id}/{hash}.jpg`, read before the bucket and written on every render or bucket fetch. Forge shares `storage/` across releases, so a deploy keeps it (noted in `ShowroomSlideCache` and the rule). `stocklist:showroom-zip-prune` removes the mirror folders of sold or deleted vehicles by the same rule and trims the mirror to 2 GB, oldest first.

Timing on a demo set (60 vehicles with a real 960 px photo, GD, local disks, no worker, poll slices):

| run | plan | drawn | slices | time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| full build, nothing cached | added 60 | 60 | 3 | 18.65 s |
| rebuild after one vehicle changed | unchanged 59, updated 1 | 1 | 1 | 0.50 s |
| rebuild, nothing changed | unchanged 60 | 0 | 1 | 0.02 s |

## 4. Lighter files

JPEG quality 82 (was 90), progressive, 4:2:0 chroma, no EXIF or ICC, the photo taken from the medium derived size (by `media_version`, saving a HEAD) and resampled once with Lanczos (Imagick) or Catmull-Rom (GD). Same result on both drivers.

Measured on one slide with a realistic photo (GD, the only driver on this machine; Imagick on the server will differ by a few kB):

| quality | size | dark band vs q90 (mean abs error, max) |
|---|---|---|
| before (q90, baseline) | 254.7 kB | reference |
| 80 | 149.0 kB | 0.29, 8 levels |
| 82 | 156.3 kB | 0.27, 7 levels |
| 85 | 168.6 kB | 0.23, 6 levels |

None of the three shows visible banding in the dark band (crops at 2x compared side by side). 80 would be the strict minimum; 82 costs 5% more and keeps the margin for the photo, so 82 it is, as proposed. On the timing set: 144 kB per slide instead of 242 (-40%), zip of 60 slides 7.6 MB. On the owner's 630-slide showroom that is roughly 90 MB where it was about 150.

Test: a slide is under 200 kB and over 30 kB with a busy photo, has a SOF2 marker and no SOF0, no APP1, no APP2.

## Tests

`ShowroomSlideTest` (10), `ShowroomDownloadTest` (29, new: manifest diff with CRCs, missing manifest and corrupt zip, mirror hit with a spy on the bucket, mirror sweep and trim, empty state), `SettingsPhoneLayoutTest`, `ScheduleTest`, `ClassReferencesResolveTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `IntegrationSmokeTest`: 101 tests, 1331 assertions, OK (one pre-existing incomplete: the Spanish gaps report).

No hot shared files touched.
params.title: Showroom slides: lighter files, room for the fuel name, and a zip that is updated instead of rebuilt
